# AstryxTreeList { #anylumino.AstryxTreeList }

```python
AstryxTreeList(items, *, header='', density='balanced', **props)
```

Render hierarchical notebook data as an expandable tree.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default      |
|---------|---------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| items   | Iterable\[Mapping\[str, Any\]\] | Item records used by generated child components or static search sources.                                                                                                                           | _required_   |
| header  | str                             | Optional header text or content.                                                                                                                                                                    | `''`         |
| density | str                             | Astryx density or spacing mode.                                                                                                                                                                     | `'balanced'` |
| **props | Any                             | JSON-safe TreeList props. Useful keys: data-testid, className, and style. anylumino manages items, header, and density. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/TreeList>. | `{}`         |
